nico.descripcion: Adult male voice: a 20-year-old man with a low-to-medium baritone pitch, clearly masculine, warm and slightly raspy. Native Latin American Spanish speaker with a neutral accent (not Spain). Casual and relaxed, like a college student chatting with a friend, natural expressive intonation, moderate pace, no exaggeration.
nico.texto_referencia: Bueno, te cuento: mañana tengo examen de matemáticas y todavía no abrí ni un apunte. ¿Me ayudas? Te prometo que esta vez me concentro.

kori.descripcion: Friendly, bright, youthful androgynous voice with a medium-high pitch, like a cheerful teenager; not squeaky, not childish. Native Latin American Spanish speaker with a neutral accent (not Spain). Upbeat, warm and confident, smiling while speaking, clear articulation, natural and human-sounding.
kori.texto_referencia: ¡Hola! Soy Kori, tu asistente de tekorei. Hoy te traigo una herramienta gratis que te va a ahorrar horas de trabajo. ¿Listo? ¡Vamos!
